title: RunBlocked
$comment: Generated by `pnpm build` in contracts/ from typespec/. Do not edit.

id.description: Unique per source. A consumer that sees the same source and id twice handles the event once.

subject.description: The ID of the thing the event is about: work item, gate, run, score or pull request.

traceparent.description: W3C trace context (CloudEvents distributed tracing extension).

runId.description: An identifier chosen by the producer. ULIDs are recommended; consumers treat it as opaque.

workItemId.description: An identifier chosen by the producer. ULIDs are recommended; consumers treat it as opaque.

waitsFor.description: What a blocked stage waits for: the checks of the run's pull request. A gate has its own `gate.requested@v1`.

pullRequest.description: The pull request whose checks the stage waits for.

checks.description: The names of the checks the stage waits for.

kind.description: Who caused something: a person, or an automated trigger such as a cron rule or an alert.

id.description: Stable ID in the source system, prefixed with the source, for example "slack:U024BE7LH".

requester.description: A person or trigger. RUNTIME-008: every run is attributed to one.

source.description: A lowercase name: letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter. Agents, stages, adapters, sources.

description: foreman: a stage of a run waits for the checks of its pull request (ADR 0127). The ID is `<run ID>.blocked.<stage>`.
